title: Dark phone tumble with split claims
summary: On black, a dark phone tumbles from its back to its screen side every 4 s and settles as a diagonal screen close-up; each claim splits into two halves flanking it. One continuous shot, seven turns, quiet premium rhythm.
use_when: A mobile app promo with no UI ready to show yet
A dark, premium hardware-feel teaser with four to six short claims
Silent autoplay where each claim gets a full 4 s hold
A trailer that should feel like one camera move, not a montage

sfx.event: phone tumbles from back to screen side (7 times)
claim halves resolve from blur beside the phone
closing heading and instruction line land

params.brand: any dark brand.json: display font, fg, muted (second title word), bg
params.content.title: two-word opening title, second word muted
params.content.claims: 3 claims, each split into a left half and a right half of 2 words each
params.content.label: one short single-line label for the quick turn (row 4)
params.content.close: two-line closing heading plus a 3-word download instruction
params.phone.color: body tint of the 3D phone (reference: dark grey, warm under light)
params.timing.period: frames between phone turns (default 120 = 4 s at 30 fps)

notes: One shot, zero cuts (cuts.json empty; near misses at 17.23 and 21.30 are phone turns). Phone turns start at 1.50, 5.50, 9.50, 13.50, 17.27, 21.50, 25.50: a 4.0 s period (120 fr@30). Each turn: edge-on -> camera back -> edge-on -> screen side in ~23-30 fr, then a ~3 s hold with a slow push-in of ~1-1.7 %/s (motion.json). Text resolves letter by letter left to right with blur, settles in ~15 fr; this and all spring choices are defaults, not measurable at 4 fps. The screen never shows UI: it is a dark fine grid texture. Claims split in two halves flank the phone, second line indented. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not used as ids): device-tumble, split-caption. Missing component: a 3D phone with a tumble path (PhoneFrame is a 2D fallback).
